name: silhouette-tokens
source: Silhouette "Brand & UI" design (v8): ink, greys and one orange (redact) on a cool grey ground. Redact is only for what can leave or has left. Every text pair meets WCAG AA.
units: Lengths are density-independent: CSS px = Android dp/sp = iOS pt. Durations in ms. Colors are sRGB hex.

colorNotes.contractKeys: background…onDanger keep the names platforms read since v1; they are aliases of the design roles below them.
colorNotes.roles: ground…leaveFocus are the design roles every platform uses; v7 gives them the new palette (block is the ink dock and rail; paper and card are the white sheet; leave is redact; mine is the ink "On this device" pill).
colorNotes.palette: night…sheet (v7) are the named colours of the System board, for what the roles do not name: night (inset box on ink), redactTint (cloud badge and cloud card), the grey ramp ink2, note, icon, faint, onInk, underline, line, track, raised.
colorNotes.redact: Redact (#FF5B1F) appears only on what can leave or has left: token chips, the Send action, the sent counter, "Sent" in the record, the What-could-leave label. Text on redact is ink (onRedact): white on redact is 3.1:1 and fails AA.
colorNotes.verdicts: There are no verdict colours: verdicts are told apart by the marker's fill level and their text, always in ink.
colorNotes.danger: There is no red. Destructive actions use ink with a trash icon and a confirmation.
colorNotes.onInk: On ink (dock, rail, sheet, modal) use white at the alpha values in `alpha.onInk` for ring, border, divider and fill.
colorNotes.dark: Dark scheme by the Android conventions board: no dynamic colour; ground ink, cards #16181B; the dock flips to light (block #F1F2F5 with ink text) so it stays the highest-contrast thing on screen; redact unchanged.
colorNotes.lines: line and blockLine are hairlines; blockLine is white at 8 % on ink, shown as its solid equivalent.

numeric.note: Tabular figures (tabular-nums) for every amount, count, time and placeholder id.

display.use: Start headline on mobile (46 to 58 by screen), capitals, line height 0.88

title.use: question, results and sheet headlines on mobile, capitals, line height 0.88

heading.use: section headlines in display caps (sheet and modal titles)

action.use: primary button label, 56 tall (v7: text, was display)

giantNumber.use: retired in v7 (no question number); kept for parsers

amount.use: yearly income and amounts in display caps

count.use: the digit in the 32 px counter (v7: was the large count)

displayKo.note: Hangul needs open leading; never below 1.0.

control.use: Details, language and other pill controls

stampCount.use: the counter digit (v7: same as count)

recordHeadline.use: "2 SENT, 1 KEPT." in the record, capitals

meta.use: row sub-line, badge reason, question count

displayPc.use: Start headline on PC (clamp up to 104)

titlePc.use: question and results headlines on PC

sizeSteps.rule: Display type starts at the design size and steps down 4 px until no word overflows its line and the headline fits its maximum lines; floor 60 % (headlines) or 66 % (labels). Display is always capitals with balanced wrap.

fontFamilyByPlatform.note: Display: Big Shoulders Display 900, always capitals, balanced wrap. Text: Inter Tight on the web, the system font on iOS, Google Sans Flex on Android. Mono: IBM Plex Mono for documents, tokens, times and requests, with tabular figures. All bundled (OFL-1.1).

shadow.note: No shadows in v7. Depth comes from a 1 px ink border at 8 % and the step from ground to sheet.

grain.native: Retired in v7: no grain. Kept at opacity 0 for parsers.

keyframes.march: dotted fill moves 8 px, loops (loading only)

motion.reducedMotion: Disable all non-essential transitions when the platform asks for reduced motion. Every keyframe above has an off switch; the preview token cross-fade becomes an instant swap.
motion.retired: v7 keeps short, medium, press, sheetUp and the standard and fade easings. Stamp, wipe, pop, docTilt, march and tokenFade belong to the old look and are no longer used (kept for parsers).

use.press: Every button, row and tile answers the finger within a frame: scale to distance.press for duration.press, released on pointer up.
use.short: A state changing in place: selection, a control becoming ready, a mark confirming. duration.short, easing.standard.
use.reveal: Something opening or arriving: a disclosure, a field under a choice, the next question (distance.step in the direction of travel), the scroll that brings it into view. duration.reveal, easing.standard.
use.exit: Leaving is faster than arriving: a sheet or modal closing, a disclosure closing. duration.exit, easing.standard.
use.medium: The moments that should be read: the counter when something leaves, a progress segment filling, results arriving the first time. duration.medium.
use.stagger: Items arriving one after another (results, values turning into chips): delay.stagger or delay.tokenStagger per item, capped at 8 items.
use.fade: Cross-fades between stages of a status line, and every movement when reduced motion is asked for (then at most duration.short).

layout.note: Widths in px. Below `wide.from` the app is one column with the privacy dock fixed to the bottom; from it, the ink rail on the left and the content area beside it.

wide.columns: From 808 px: the ink rail (248) on the left with the wordmark, For judges and Draft rules, the three steps with their state, and the counter with Details at the bottom; the content area is one column up to 760 px; from twoColumnsFrom (1100 px of window) two columns up to 1100 px (the results list beside a program, the two documents of the silhouette, Start's example beside its headline), before that one column; padding clamp 20–72. Modal instead of bottom sheet (max 520, radius 28, scrim 48 %).
wide.panelTop: The rail runs the full height.

phone.note: Mobile: gutter 20, the dock at the bottom with radius 28 at the top.

alpha.note: Opacity values (0–1) for the transparent colours of the System board. Colours stay #RRGGBB in `color`.

rotationNote: Retired in v7: nothing is rotated. Kept at 0 for parsers.
